name: prdb
description: Identifies adult videos in your Jellyfin movie libraries by file hash and file name against prdb.net and fills in their title, description, release date, site, performers and images. Read-only: the plugin submits nothing to prdb. Requires the API key of a prdb account. Setup guide: https://github.com/prdb-net/prdb-jellyfin#setup
overview: Metadata for your videos from prdb.net

versions.changelog: Studio collections: an optional collection per site and network, for TV clients without a Studios tab
Setup guide: library recommendations on the configuration page and in the README
First release: identifies videos by OSHash and file name against prdb.net
